description: MUTATES Parabol data: send team invitations by email. Required: teamId and invitees (an array of email addresses). Optionally scope to a meetingId. Parabol GraphQL: inviteToTeam(teamId, invitees). Requires TEAMS_WRITE.

meetingId.description: Optionally associate the invitation with a meeting id.

teamId.description: The team id to invite into (required).

name: invite_to_team
title: Invite users to a team
